limitations: invoice_contract_association REJECT disposition for INV-4001/SOW-VEL-2022 was adjudicated (OBL-031) but omitted from world.sqlite; Purpose A cannot surface that negative association.

commercial_relationship_identity_candidate is COMPLETE over crm_account_observation span but omits some adjudicated identity_judgment pairs (e.g. billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH to contract:MSA-OAK-2018); Purpose B emits only the 18 candidate pairs.
Purpose outputs are not persisted as TaskView relations; derive_purposes.py writes purpose_ir JSON directly.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical filter; no unresolved disposition. Paid invoices are excluded deterministically.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over invoice_observation universe: every sourced invoice with status open appears.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT invoice, invoice_id, status FROM invoice_observation WHERE status = 'open'
derivations.required_premise: invoice_observation.status reflects sourced billing status verbatim.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Generates undirected candidate identity pairs along commercial spans; does not assert SAME_ENTITY or DISTINCT.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over crm_account_observation: every CRM account with a contract correspondence yields span pairs to billing, contract, and name-compatible registry candidates.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Span expansion from account_contract_code_correspondence joined to invoices sharing billed names and registry rows with legal-form-compatible names.
derivations.required_premise: account_contract_code_correspondence tokens deterministically link CRM accounts to governing contracts.
derivations.optional_enrichment: legal_form_mechanical_equivalence widens registry name-compatibility candidates without asserting identity.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Emits asserted or unresolved association per invoice_contract_association; does not infer association from name compatibility alone.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Row coverage over invoice_contract_association tuples whose contract is active and bears at least one acquisition-relevant clause kind per Purpose A policy.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Join invoice_observation to invoice_contract_association; filter active contracts with acquisition-relevant clause kinds; render identifiers without referent prefixes.
derivations.required_premise: invoice_contract_association tuple exists for the invoice; contract_document_observation.active is true; contract_clause_observation contains a Purpose A acquisition-relevant kind.
derivations.optional_enrichment: identity_judgment may ground asserted associations but is not re-derived at purpose layer.

non_blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Invoice row is still emitted when other inclusion premises hold; unresolved linkage is reported explicitly.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Maps adjudicated identity_judgment dispositions to epistemic SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED; absent judgment defaults to UNRESOLVED.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Link coverage equals commercial_relationship_identity_candidate cardinality; does not emit exhaustive all-pairs beyond required topology.
derivations.deterministic_computation: For each candidate pair, lookup identity_judgment disposition (symmetric); sort by left then right.
derivations.required_premise: commercial_relationship_identity_candidate pair is in the required commercial relationship span.
derivations.optional_enrichment: legal_form_mechanical_equivalence informed candidate generation upstream but is not joined at purpose layer.

non_blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Link is emitted with UNRESOLVED; absence of SAME_ENTITY is not treated as DISTINCT.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Two-part test: current relationship (open invoice OR active continuing-term contract) AND dependency obligation kind; unresolved identity or invoice association forces status unresolved.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Emit a row for each active contract bearing exclusivity, auto_renewal, or rolling_term that satisfies prong 1 or must be reported unresolved due to identity joins.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Filter active contracts with dependency obligation kinds; evaluate prong 1 via open_invoice or continuing-term clauses; set status dependent only when invoice_contract_association and billing-to-contract identity are asserted.
derivations.required_premise: contract_document_observation.active is true; contract_clause_observation includes at least one of exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term; prong 1 satisfied by open_invoice link or continuing-term clause on active contract.
derivations.optional_enrichment: account_contract_code_correspondence supplies counterparty identifier when no billing invoice is linked.

blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Blocks dependent status; row emitted as status unresolved.
Blocks dependent status when billing-to-contract SAME_ENTITY is required and not established.

non_blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Non-blocking for registry-only candidate pairs not on the invoice-contract join path used for dependency classification.
